_notice: FICTITIOUS. Generated laboratory results for patients who do not exist, taking a product that does not exist. The values are simulated and are not medical information. Test codes are LOINC codes (see the LICENSE file for the LOINC notice); reference ranges are typical adult values chosen for this pack.
usage: One record per specimen. For every patient who started QUORVANTA (patients.therapy.started_on): a baseline complete blood count, liver tests and renal function before starting (label 2.1); a blood count 3 months after starting and every 6 months after that (2.4); liver tests when clinically indicated; and, for patients who stopped because of lymphopenia, blood counts until recovery (5.4). eGFR is computed from creatinine, age and sex by the CKD-EPI 2021 equation. patterns marks clinically meaningful situations; quality_flags marks data problems. --count sets how many patients are monitored.

quality_flags.unit_mismatch: The lymphocyte count is reported in cells/uL (unit '/uL') instead of 10*9/L, so it reads 1000 times too high.
quality_flags.duplicate: The same result sent twice under a new record id; 'of' is the original.
quality_flags.canceled_specimen: The specimen could not be tested (status canceled, cancel_reason set) and was recollected.
quality_flags.lab_certificate_lapsed: Reported by a lab whose CLIA certificate had lapsed before collection.

patterns.low_baseline_lymphocytes: Baseline lymphocyte count below 1.0 x 10^9/L. The label has no data on starting in low counts (5.4; GAP-08).
patterns.prolonged_severe_lymphopenia: Lymphocyte counts below 0.5 x 10^9/L for at least 6 months up to this result; the label says to consider interrupting treatment (5.4).
patterns.alt_above_3x_uln: ALT more than 3 times the upper limit of normal.
patterns.hepatic_signal: ALT above 5 times and total bilirubin above 2 times the upper limit of normal (5.5).
patterns.moderate_renal_impairment_at_baseline: Baseline eGFR 30 to 59; the label does not recommend QUORVANTA in moderate or severe renal impairment (8.6).
patterns.missed_previous_scheduled_cbc: The scheduled blood count before this one was never done.
patterns.overdue_at_as_of: The next scheduled blood count is more than 30 days overdue on the as_of date; 'due' gives the date.
patterns.follow_up_after_discontinuation: A blood count after stopping QUORVANTA for lymphopenia, continued until recovery (5.4).
